question: Does the persistent B01 R1024_T32 V02 Reference-Richards shadow solve return to the same full pressure-head and nonlinear residual vectors on the 24-iteration recurrence indicated by RNP02 aggregate diagnostics?

snapshots.encoding: IEEE-754 real64 bit pattern emitted as 16-digit hexadecimal

preregistered_interpretation.FULL_VECTOR_PAIR_RECURRENCE: For a preregistered pair, every active-node pressure-head bit pattern and every active-node residual bit pattern is identical.
preregistered_interpretation.MULTIPAIR_FULL_VECTOR_RECURRENCE: All three preregistered target pairs satisfy FULL_VECTOR_PAIR_RECURRENCE.
preregistered_interpretation.AGGREGATE_ONLY_RECURRENCE: RNP02 aggregate recurrence is present but at least one full-vector pair differs.
preregistered_interpretation.CONTROL_PRESERVATION: R2048 control remains SW_SOLVE_CONVERGED under the unchanged 128-cap diagnostic.

prohibited: No production HeadCalc or Reference Richards change.
No solver-policy/admission change from RNP03 itself.
decision_boundary: If MULTIPAIR_FULL_VECTOR_RECURRENCE is confirmed, ROM-ROOT treats the Stage-1 blocker as a Reference-Richards numerical-method cycle and hands further method changes outside the ROM candidate workstream.
